processingNote: Asset Recovery Wave 3 (2026-08-18): mesh-decimation derivative produced from the original CONDITIONAL-for-size source via gltf-transform (weld + simplify, meshoptimizer backend, ratio=0.15, error=0.005). Weld alone (vertex dedup) reduced the file from 93.13MB to 63.22MB before simplification; POSITION/NORMAL/COLOR_0 attributes preserved, no color remap or recognizability fix attempted (those are separate, non-technical open issues, not in scope for this derivative). No license or attribution facts changed. Original file preserved unmodified alongside this derivative.

validation.notes: Bounding box unchanged from source within float rounding (delta <0.001 on one axis). ~9.8x file-size reduction, from 93.1MB (6.2x over the 15MB guideline) to 9.46MB (well under budget). Open, unresolved concerns carried over from the source visual review and NOT addressed by this derivative: (1) saturated rainbow chain coloring clashes with the app's warm-off-white/clean-3D style bar; (2) the ribosome's amorphous blob shape has inherently low silhouette recognizability for a child audience regardless of decimation level, and will still lean on hotspot/label-driven 'Name it'/'Explain it' teaching rather than 'See it' recognition. Both are scientific/style concerns, out of scope for a technical size-reduction pass -- flagged for a dedicated visual-acceptance review and/or a future muted-recolor pass.
